conviction_note: The FY26 guide was already re-stated on 28 Sep, with Q3 almost done, at the lower end of £910-960m EBITDA because of Brazil. BetMGM's Q3 came out on 13 Oct and the stock rose 4.7% that day. So the release adds little the market has not seen: the Q3 online NGR print, which the company has already signalled at about +7% cc excluding Brazil, plus any capital-return or CEE comment. The CFO bought £100k of stock on 1 Oct, the day after the quarter closed, which is a mild positive. Last year the stock rose on the BetMGM day and gave the gain back on the trading-update day, which is a mild negative. p_up 54 on abs 4.0 gives +0.32. The findings sum to +0.2. The two measurements agree in sign and are about the same size.

findings.finding: CFO Michael Snape bought 24,013 shares at 416.42p (~£100k) on 1 Oct 2026, the day after Q3 closed and three days after the Brazil statement. This follows a 51,815-share (~£250k) purchase at 482.47p on 18 Sep. A finance director buying after quarter-end, two weeks before the Q3 update, implies he held no inside information on a Q3 materially worse than the 28 Sep guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history of this name reacting to a PDMR buy. Q3 updates moved +2.84% (2024) and -2.43% (2025).
findings.why_not_priced: The dealing notice was published on 2 Oct and the stock has risen since (413 -> 446p), much of it on BetMGM. If the market had fully read the purchase as 'no Q3 miss', the short register would have kept falling to well under 4%, and the stock would not have lagged 60 days -19% while trading at about half last October's price. Partly priced, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Same-direction evidence from a different document: the 28 Sep RNS said 'Excluding Brazil, Entain remains on track to deliver FY26 Online NGR growth at the top end of its guidance' (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/entain--ent/fy26-ebitda-maintained-guide-despite-brazil-ban/9792678).

findings.finding: Q3 2025, the comparison period, carried a 1-2pp adverse sports-results hit in September (Online NGR ex-US +6% cc, International online +1% cc, Brazil -11% cc, Australia -6% cc). If Q3 2026 sports margins are normal, the YoY print flatters. BetMGM's US Q3 GGR hold rose 55bps YoY to 10.7%, showing at least US sports outcomes were not adverse.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 TU reported the adverse-results hit and the stock fell 2.43%. Q3 2024 online NGR beat and guide upgrade: +2.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: The company told the market on 28 Sep that ex-Brazil online NGR is tracking the top end of 5-7%, with most of Q3 already known to it. So the easy comp is largely inside what was guided, and I sized it near 0. What is not public is the exact Q3 figure and the September sports margin outside the US. No European peer has reported Q3 yet.
findings.independence: BetMGM Q3 hold data (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/entain--ent/betmgm-q3-2026-update-/9820594). This is a US-only proxy for sports outcomes.

findings.finding: Reaction pattern: last year BetMGM's Q3 update (14 Oct 2025) lifted ENT +1.7% (825.0 -> 839.4p) and the Entain Q3 TU the next day gave it back, -2.43% (-> 819.0p). This year the BetMGM day was +4.7% (427.9 -> 448.1p) and the stock was flat to slightly down intraday on 14 Oct (446.2p sealed), so the US read-through is already in the price going into the TU.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: n=1 analogue (Oct 2025 -2.43% on TU day after the BetMGM pop). 5-day run-up into this print +7.96%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a reaction-function claim, not a fact about the print. If the market expected BetMGM to be re-priced on 15 Oct, the 13 Oct gain would not have held through 14 Oct. It is one prior observation, so it is small.
findings.independence: Tape for 2026-10-13/14 from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ENT.L?range=2mo&interval=1d. Same price source, a different window.

findings.finding: FY26 EBITDA guide (£910-960m, towards the lower end) and online margin (21-22%) were re-stated on 28 Sep 2026 with Q3 nearly complete. The base case is a reiteration that carries nothing new.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 28 Sep guide statement: 449.6p (25 Sep) -> 426.9p (28 Sep), -5.0%. The Brazil ban news and the guide landed together.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it is public and the stock re-rated on it. I filed it because it decides the size of the move rather than its direction. A further cut below the range is the downside tail; a firming within the range is the upside.

findings.finding: Barclays PLC's TR-1 shows its holding rising to 6.01% on 29 Sep (0.85% shares, 5.16% CFDs/portfolio swaps/equity swaps), up from 5.50% before 15 Sep. This is synthetic exposure held for clients, and its direction depends on the clients behind it.
findings.why_not_priced: Swap-book exposure on a prime-broker TR-1 cannot be signed without knowing the client side, so it is sized at 0.
